sprint: Six-Day Method A Reproduction Sprint (7-13 November 2026)
milestone_gate: Gate 5 (Refined Method A Production Fracture Simulation Final Execution Gate)

warning_classification.pattern: ***WARNING: THE *ELEMENT OUTPUT OPTION IS NOT SUPPORTED FOR USER ELEMENTS

submission_script.preflight_checks: Lock check, >=10 GB free scratch verification, bitwise input/UEL SHA-256 assertions, fail-safe notifications

hpc_resource_and_scheduler_evidence.queue_architecture: Route queue directing to normal_imfdfkmq / short_imfdfkmq
hpc_resource_and_scheduler_evidence.execution_architecture: Single-rank serial Abaqus/Standard (authoritative reference anchor, strict single-rank UEL requirement)

storage_and_scratch_quota_budget.filesystem_status: panfs://mpanfs/scratch9: Size 33 TB, Used 14 TB, Available 20 TB (42% used)

disk_growth_budget.restart_file_res: Estimated 0.35 to 0.50 GB for ~250-500 increments (0.78 MB baseline per step from datacheck)
disk_growth_budget.output_database_odb: Estimated 0.60 to 0.80 GB for 500 increments saving element SDVs and reference node forces
disk_growth_budget.solver_text_logs: Less than 5 MB (msg, dat, prt, sta)
disk_growth_budget.storage_safety_margin: With 20 TB free and unlimited user quota, 1.5 GB represents < 0.0075% of available capacity
disk_growth_budget.preflight_guard: PBS script asserts >= 10 GB free scratch disk space before solver invocation

material_properties.residual_stiffness_k_res: 1.0e-7 (PROPS(5): residual stiffness parameter preventing numerical singularity when d -> 1; not viscous damping)

loading_schedule.initial_state: Undeformed, undamaged, stress-free with rectangular notch (y in [0.499, 0.501] mm, x <= 0.500 mm)

step_1.name: Step-1
step_1.physical_meaning: Pre-critical linear-elastic loading up to 0.0050 mm displacement

step_2.name: Step-2
step_2.physical_meaning: Post-critical fracture propagation from 0.0050 mm to 0.0120 mm

reaction_force.source: *NODE OUTPUT and *NODE PRINT in Step-1 and Step-2

displacement.source: *NODE OUTPUT and *NODE PRINT in Step-1 and Step-2

phase_field_damage.components: SDV1 / SDV14 on CPE4/CPE3 companion elements, mapped to element centroids and nodes in post-processing
phase_field_damage.note: Full-domain nodal U3 field output is not requested; damage reconstruction relies exclusively on companion SDV1/SDV14 integration point data

companion_state_variables.components: S (zero in coupled solve), E (strains), SDV (history field H=SDV2, degradation g=SDV15)
companion_state_variables.miseseri_note: Companion UMAT returns zero stress during coupled solve; authentic nonzero MISESERI belongs to the auxiliary static recovery step

energy_balance_reconstruction.external_work_reconstruction: Reconstructed post-process via trapezoidal numerical integration of P(u): W_ext = sum 0.5 * (P_i + P_{i-1}) * (u_i - u_{i-1})
energy_balance_reconstruction.global_energy_balance_definition: Delta E = W_ext - (E_elastic + E_fracture), evaluated across all recorded increments

restart_states.configuration: *RESTART, WRITE, FREQUENCY=1 in Step-1 and Step-2

telegram_integration.events: notify_start on initialization, terminal traps on COMPLETED / FAILED / TERMINATED
telegram_integration.fail_safe_wrapper: Notification warnings or network glitches will not abort the scientific computation

dual_channel_notifications_and_monitorin.duplicate_prevention: Unique job name M1_HOLE_F1664_METHOD_A_PROD, isolated scratch directory /scratch9/pr21vyci/runs/mode1_method_a_hole_f1664_prod

failure_recovery_policy.policy: No blind reruns or automated resubmissions. If non-convergence occurs, capture .msg, .dat, and .odb, diagnose the exact increment and equilibrium residual, and formulate an independently reviewed numerical hypothesis before any change.

criterion_1_convergence.description: Complete traversal of pre-critical loading (Step-1) and post-peak softening progress through ligament severance and crack deflection.
criterion_1_convergence.threshold: Step-1 completed (u = 0.0050 mm) + Step-2 traversed past peak load with softening towards near-zero force; physical ligament severance is accepted even if numerical termination occurs before 0.0120 mm

criterion_2_numerical_stability.description: Absence of numerical divergence, NaN, Inf, or unhandled UEL/UMAT exceptions in any output field or energy file.
criterion_2_numerical_stability.threshold: Zero NaN/Inf in nodal displacements, reaction forces, or energy balance

criterion_3_force_displacement_response.description: Physically consistent P(u) curve exhibiting linear-elastic slope, distinct peak force, and smooth post-peak softening.
criterion_3_force_displacement_response.threshold: Linear initial response with stiffness matching benchmark, well-defined peak

criterion_4_peak_force_reproducibility.description: Peak reaction force P_max within expected nominal comparison band for the off-axis hole geometry.
criterion_4_peak_force_reproducibility.threshold: Nominal comparison band [0.60, 0.80] kN; deviations due to fine mesh resolution (h_min = 1.0 um) or localized softening will be investigated quantitatively rather than automatically rejected

criterion_5_crack_path_fidelity.description: Primary crack deflects into the circular hole; secondary crack initiates on the right hole boundary and propagates toward the right edge.
criterion_5_crack_path_fidelity.threshold: Topology matches Pandey-Kumar (2025) Figure 12 / 13 and coarse Job 1421063

criterion_6_energy_conservation.description: Fracture energy monotonically non-decreasing; global reconstructed energy error bounded.
criterion_6_energy_conservation.threshold: d(W_frac)/dt >= 0; Delta E = W_ext - (E_elas + E_frac) evaluated and documented

criterion_7_benchmark_comparison.description: Direct quantitative comparison against coarse reference (Job 1421063) and literature benchmark.
criterion_7_benchmark_comparison.threshold: Peak force, crack arrival displacement, and computational cost documented in comparative report
